versions.content: The Bus Mirroring module shall poll the status of each active CAN source bus by cyclically calling CanIf_GetControllerMode and CanIf_Get- TrcvMode from the Mirror_MainFunction . If the returned ControllerModePtr is CAN_CS_STARTED and the returned TransceiverModePtr is CANTRCV_TRCV- MODE_NORMAL , the reported CAN source bus state shall be set to online, otherwise 24 of 117  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 873: AUTOSAR_SWS_BusMirroring Specification of Bus Mirroring AUTOSAR CP R19-11 to offline. If the bus is online, the Bus Mirroring module shall call CanIf_GetCon- trollerErrorState , and if the returned ErrorStatePtr is CAN_ERRORSTATE_- PASSIVE or CAN_ERRORSTATE_BUSOFF , the reported CAN source bus state shall be set to error passive or bus-off, respectively. Additionally, if the bus is online, the Bus Mirroring module shall also call CanIf_GetControllerTxErrorCounter , and add the returned TxErrorCounterPtr to the reported CAN source bus state.
